## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A seven-*juan* Northern-Sòng compilation by **Fúzōng Jìzhōng** 扶宗繼忠 (1012–1082) documenting the doctrinal differences between **Sìmíng Zhīlǐ** 四明知禮 (the *shānjiā* tradition founder, [知禮](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E7%9F%A5%E7%A6%AE)) and **Rényuè** 仁岳 (the principal *shānwài* spokesperson, [仁岳](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E4%BB%81%E5%B2%B3)). The work is the most extensive single documentary record of the *shānjiā* / *shānwài* polemical exchange.

**Abstract**

The composition is bracketed within Jìzhōng's productive period c. 1040–1082.
